description: Version-locked workflow for an entity-, lineage-, shared-control-dependence- and calibration-aware reliability audit of TCM Transcriptomic Atlas v6. It records environment validation, provenance reconstruction, covariance-aware calibration and the prespecified descriptive release selected after both candidate inferential methods failed mandatory calibration. The archived workflow excludes third-party expression matrices, restricted gene-set bytes, production results, formal checkpoints and sealed external outcomes; full reconstruction requires lawful reacquisition of the identified third-party inputs. It does not authorise p/q-value generation, pathway ranking, confirmatory inference, mechanism or efficacy claims, or external-outcome unsealing.
name: TCM atlas reliability audit and descriptive release workflow
